school: 元气自然论/批判理性主义
historical_significance: 东汉唯物主义思想家，字仲任，会稽上虞人。以《论衡》八十五篇系统批判谶纬神学、天人感应说和鬼神迷信，创立中国古代最完整的怀疑论哲学体系。其疾虚妄、立真伪的认识论立场早于欧洲文艺复兴时期的怀疑论约一千五百年，比西方科学革命早约一千五百年确立了自然运作无需目的因的思想。首次系统论证雷电自然成因、水循环过程，开创问孔刺孟先河，直接质疑儒家圣人权威。与董仲舒同处汉代但完全对立：董仲舒建构天人感应神学，王充解构之；董仲舒诉诸经典权威，王充诉诸经验验证。
core_thoughts: 疾虚妄法（对所有未经验证的主张保持系统性怀疑）
问难法（通过不断提问和挑战检验命题真伪）
天道自然法（将天道理解为人格化的自然过程而非有意志的干预者）
效验论证法（主张必须有可检验的证据支持）
归谬反驳法（通过推导逻辑后果揭示矛盾或荒谬）
元气自然论（以气为本体解释一切现象）
常识经验法（用日常经验和常识检验理论标准）
文本批判法（对经典文本持批判性态度）
机械因果法（用物质性的因果关系取代目的论和感应论解释）
反权威立真法（拒绝将权威、传统或多数人的意见作为真理标准）
famous_quote: 疾虚妄，立真伪；考之以心，效之以事；凡论事者，决其信否，案验其事；天行有常，不为尧存，不为桀亡
influence: 创立中国古代最系统的批判理性方法论体系，比欧洲文艺复兴时期的怀疑论早约一千五百年建立系统性怀疑论哲学；首次系统解释雷电自然成因和水循环过程，开创问孔刺孟先河直接质疑儒家圣人权威；其疾虚妄、立真伪的方法论闭环为后世无神论传统、清代考据学、现代科学思维教育提供了古典资源。与董仲舒形成汉代思想的对立两极：董仲舒建构天人感应神学，王充以经验验证解构之。与桓谭同反对谶纬但王充方法论更系统完整；与张衡同时代但维度不同，张衡在仪器制造和天文学有实证成就，王充在哲学层面提供自然主义理论支撑。

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以批判虚妄、追求真实为核心使命，对所有未经检验的主张保持系统性怀疑态度。在《论衡·佚文》《论衡·对作》中，他明确提出疾虚妄不仅是一种方法论，更是一种认识论立场：凡是不能验证的说法都值得怀疑，怀疑本身不是目的，而是通向真实的手段。这一立场贯穿其全部著述，构成其思维体系的第一原则。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Taking the criticism of falsehood and pursuit of truth as core mission, maintaining systematic skepticism toward all unexamined claims. In Lunheng chapters on佚文 and 对作, he explicitly states that disease of falsehood is not merely a methodological tool but an epistemological stance: any claim that cannot be verified deserves skepticism; skepticism itself is not the end but a means to truth. This position runs through all his writings, forming the first principle of his thinking system.
process_zh: 确立批判性姿态，对所有未经验证的主张保持系统性怀疑
区分可验证主张与不可验证主张（虚妄）
将怀疑作为通向真实的手段而非目的
以疾虚妄为认识论第一原则贯穿全部著述

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过不断提问和挑战来检验命题的真伪，要求每一个主张都要有明确的机制解释。在《论衡·问孔》《论衡·刺孟》《论衡·正失》中，他直接质疑孔子、孟子言论中的矛盾和不一致之处。问难不是为质疑而质疑，而是为了逼近真实；关键在于要求明白——每一个主张必须说清楚其含义、机制和后果。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Continuously questioning and challenging to test the truth of propositions, requiring each claim to have a clear mechanism explanation. In Lunheng chapters 问孔, 刺孟, and 正失, he directly questioned contradictions and inconsistencies in the words of Confucius and Mencius. Questioning is not for its own sake but to approach truth; the key is demanding clarity — each claim must explain its meaning, mechanism and consequences.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《论衡·问孔》《论衡·刺孟》《论衡·正失》
process_zh: 识别主张中的模糊定义和不一致之处
对每个主张提出明确的定义性问题
要求清晰的含义、机制和后果说明
通过逐层追问逼近真实

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 将天道理解为人格化的自然过程而非有意志的干预者。在《论衡·自然》《论衡·物势》《论衡·谴告》中，他指出天没有目的，不赏善罚恶，只是气之自然运行。如果天有意志，为何自然灾害不区分善恶地发生？这种目的论解释与观察事实不符。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Understanding heaven as a natural process rather than an intentional intervener. In Lunheng chapters 自然, 物势, and 谴告, he pointed out that heaven has no purpose, does not reward good or punish evil, but is merely the natural operation of qi. If heaven had will, why do natural disasters not distinguish between good and evil? Such teleological explanations contradict observed facts.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《论衡·自然》《论衡·物势》《论衡·谴告》
process_zh: 识别目的论解释与观察事实的矛盾
论证自然灾害不区分善恶地发生
将天理解释为无目的的自然过程
确立机械因果论取代目的论宇宙观

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 主张必须有可检验的证据支持，不接受仅凭权威或传统的论断。在《论衡·证明》《论衡·知实》《论衡·案书》中，他强调案验原则：用实际事实来对照主张是否符合。这与中国传统学术中的诉诸经典传统截然不同。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Claims must have verifiable evidence support, not accepting arguments based solely on authority or tradition. In Lunheng chapters 证明, 知实, and 案书, he emphasized the principle of 案验: using actual facts to check whether claims conform. This is fundamentally different from the Chinese academic tradition of appealing to classics.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《论衡·证明》《论衡·知实》《论衡·案书》
process_zh: 识别主张的可检验性
用实际事实对照主张是否符合
拒绝仅凭权威或传统的论断
将经验验证确立为检验真理的最高标准

thinking_modes.name_en: Reductio ad Absurdum Method (Logical Contradiction Exposure)
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过推导主张的逻辑后果来揭示其矛盾或荒谬。若承认某主张，则需接受一系列不合理结论，故该主张必误。在《论衡·道虚》《论衡·死伪》《论衡·纪妖》中，他大量使用归谬法批判鬼神迷信和成仙传说。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Revealing contradictions or absurdity by deriving the logical consequences of a claim. If accepting a claim requires accepting a series of unreasonable conclusions, then the claim must be wrong. In Lunheng chapters 道虚, 死伪, and 纪妖, he extensively used reductio ad absurdum to criticize supernatural beliefs and immortals legends.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《论衡·道虚》《论衡·死伪》《论衡·纪妖》
process_zh: 接受对手主张作为前提
推导该主张的逻辑后果
揭示不合理或自相矛盾的结论
证明原主张必然错误

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以气为本体解释一切现象，气的聚散构成万物的生成变化，无需借助任何超自然力量或目的因。在《论衡·谈天》《论衡·感虚》《论衡·龙虚》中，他将所有现象还原为物质的气和形，解释为气的聚散、升降、感应过程。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Explaining all phenomena through qi (primordial substance) as the ontological basis; the condensation and dispersion of qi constitutes the generation and transformation of all things, without relying on any supernatural forces or teleological causes. In Lunheng chapters 谈天, 感虚, and 龙虚, he reduced all phenomena to material qi and form, explaining them as processes of qi's condensation, dispersion, elevation, descent, and interaction.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《论衡·谈天》《论衡·感虚》《论衡·龙虚》
process_zh: 将所有现象还原为物质性的气和形
解释为气的聚散、升降、感应过程
拒绝任何超自然力量或目的因的解释
构建完整的唯物主义本体论框架

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 用日常经验和常识作为检验理论的标准，反对将复杂化、神秘化的解释强加于简单自然现象之上。在《论衡·说日》《论衡·雷虚》《论衡·变动》中，他常常以凡人见识莫能独觉开头，然后用普通人的常识反驳复杂精致的理论。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Using daily experience and common sense as the standard for testing theories, opposing complex and mysterious explanations imposed on simple natural phenomena. In Lunheng chapters 说日, 雷虚, and 变动, he often began with ordinary people's common perception and then used everyday common sense to refute complex sophisticated theories.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《论衡·说日》《论衡·雷虚》《论衡·变动》
process_zh: 识别日常经验和常识中的基本事实
将复杂理论还原为可验证的日常经验
用普通人的感知能力参与真理判断
建立民主化的认识论标准

thinking_modes.name_en: Textual Criticism Method (Independent Verification of Classics)
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 对经典文本持批判性态度，区分哪些是真孔孟之言，哪些是后人伪托或误传。在《论衡·问孔》《论衡·刺孟》《论衡·书虚》中，他指出许多被当作圣人之言的内容其实是后世附会。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Maintaining a critical attitude toward classical texts, distinguishing which are genuine words of Confucius and Mencius and which were later fabrications or misinterpretations. In Lunheng chapters 问孔, 刺孟, and 书虚, he pointed out that much content treated as words of sages was actually later apocryphal additions.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《论衡·问孔》《论衡·刺孟》《论衡·书虚》
process_zh: 对经典文本保持批判性审视
区分真孔孟之言与后世附会
建立独立于权威的文本检验标准
为后世的辨伪学奠定基础

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 用物质性的因果关系取代目的论和感应论解释，要求每个现象都有清晰的物质性原因链条。在《论衡·雷虚》《论衡·感虚》《论衡·顺鼓》中，他指出雷电不过是阴阳之气相搏产生的火，是自然现象而非意志行为。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Replacing teleological and sympathetic explanations with material causal relationships, requiring each phenomenon to have a clear chain of material causes. In Lunheng chapters 雷虚, 感虚, and 顺鼓, he pointed out that lightning is merely fire produced by the struggle of yin and yang qi — a natural phenomenon, not an act of will.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《论衡·雷虚》《论衡·感虚》《论衡·顺鼓》
process_zh: 识别现象的物质性原因链条
拒绝目的论和神秘感应解释
将自然现象还原为气的相互作用
建立系统性的物质因果解释框架

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 拒绝将权威、传统或多数人的意见作为真理标准。无论主张来自孔子还是世俗大众，都必须经过独立检验。在《论衡·问孔》《论衡·非韩》《论衡·别通》中，他明确指出真理不因来自权威而成立。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Refusing to take authority, tradition, or majority opinion as the standard of truth. Regardless of whether a claim comes from Confucius or common people, it must undergo independent verification. In Lunheng chapters 问孔, 非韩, and 别通, he explicitly stated that truth does not hold simply because it comes from authority.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《论衡·问孔》《论衡·非韩》《论衡·别通》
process_zh: 识别主张来源（权威或大众）
拒绝将来源作为真理标准
对所有主张进行独立检验
确立认知自主为独立思考的核心原则

cross_references.relation_type: 宇宙论对照：天人感应神学 vs 天道自然论
cross_references.description_zh: 董仲舒与王充同处汉代天人关系战场，立场正相反：董仲舒把天人格化为有意志的赏罚者，灾异谴告构成政治神学；王充以「天地合气，万物自生」取消天的意志，谴告说是人心投射。一个以神学维系纲常，一个以自然主义清剿虚妄，构成汉代宇宙论的两极。
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: H-DZS-001 档案可从「天人感应的目的论宇宙观」接此条。

cross_references.relation_type: 气本论接力：元气一元论与太虚即气
cross_references.description_zh: 王充以「万物之生，皆禀元气」立气一元论并用于批判（形亡神灭、无鬼）；张载八百年后以「太虚即气」重建气本论并用于建构（民胞物与、仇必和而解）。同一条气学路线，王充取其破坏性锋刃，张载取其建设性体量，构成中国气论从批判武器到形上体系的接力。
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: H-ZZ-001 档案可从「太虚即气的气一元论」接此条。

cross_references.relation_type: 权威检验对照：尊圣与问圣
cross_references.description_zh: 孔子被王充选为检验对象而非打倒对象：问孔刺孟的每一问都以「若圣人有此说，何以解释矛盾」展开，结论常常是「此非圣人之言，乃后人增益」——文本批判保全了真实的孔子而清剿了被神化的孔子。与后世「尊圣即免检」的经学态度相比，王充提供了对权威「检验而不否定」的第三条路。
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: H-KZ-001 档案可从「圣人形象的后世层累」接此条。

modes.definition_zh: 「疾虚妄」——《论衡》全书的总纲与认识论立场：对一切未经检验的主张保持系统性怀疑，不论其来自圣人、经典、世俗还是众口。王充自述「《诗》三百，一言以蔽之，曰：思无邪；《论衡》篇以十数，亦一言也，曰：疾虚妄」。虚妄不仅指明显的迷信，更指一切被反复转述而脱离了事实根基的言说——虚妄的传播机制本身（夸饰、附会、以讹传讹）就是批判对象。求真不是被动等待真理呈现，而是主动清剿虚妄后的剩余。
modes.definition_en: Lun Heng's master maxim: maintain systematic skepticism toward all unexamined claims, whether from sages, classics, convention, or the crowd. Wang Chong declared that 'the Lun Heng in one phrase: combating falsehood.' Falsehood includes not just obvious superstition but any saying detached from factual grounding through retelling—exaggeration, glossing, cumulative distortion are themselves the critical targets. Truth-seeking is not passive awaiting but what remains after actively clearing away the false.
modes.key_quote_zh: 《诗》三百，一言以蔽之，曰：思无邪。《论衡》篇以十数，亦一言也，曰：疾虚妄。
modes.key_quote_en: 'Three hundred odes, one sentence covers them: think no evil. The Lun Heng's dozens of chapters, one phrase covers them too: combating falsehood.'
process_zh: 识别主张的事实根基：它最初由谁基于什么观察提出
剥离转述积累的夸饰与附会成分
用经验与逻辑检验剥离后的核心主张
把「实」立为判断标准：实者诚，妄者伪
process_en: Identify the factual root of a claim: who proposed it from what observation
Strip away accumulated exaggeration and gloss from retelling
Test the stripped core claim against experience and logic
Establish "the real" as the criterion: the real is true, the contrived is false
representative_cases_zh: 《论衡》全书对九虚（书虚/变虚/异虚/感虚/福虚/祸虚/龙虚/雷虚/道虚）与三增（语增/儒增/艺增）的系统清理
自述著书动机：众书并失其实，故作《论衡》
representative_cases_en: Systematic audit of the "nine falsehoods" and "three exaggerations" across the Lun Heng
Stated motive: since all books had lost the real, the Lun Heng was written

modes.definition_zh: 以连续追问检验命题：每一个主张都必须给出明确的机制解释——它究竟是什么意思、如何运作、原因何在。王充在《问孔》《刺孟》中把问难做成系统方法：不是为质疑而质疑，而是以问题为解剖刀，切开后才能看到命题内部是肌肉还是空洞。他追问孔子「予所否者，天厌之」的逻辑后果，追问「货殖焉耳，空虚无籍」与孔子行为的矛盾——问孔不是毁孔，是把孔子当作可检验的同行者而非不可质疑的偶像。
modes.definition_en: Test propositions by sustained questioning: every claim must yield a clear mechanistic explanation—what it means, how it operates, why it occurs. In "Questioning Confucius" and "Prodding Mencius," Wang Chong made interrogative testing systematic: not doubt for its own sake, but questions as scalpels that reveal whether a proposition contains substance or void. Questioning Confucius was not desecration but treating him as a testable peer rather than an unquestionable idol.
modes.source_chapter: 《论衡·问孔》《论衡·刺孟》《论衡·正失》
modes.key_quote_zh: 苟有不晓解之问，迢难孔子，何伤于义？诚有传圣业之知，伐孔子之说，何逆于理？
modes.key_quote_en: If there is a question one does not understand, why should pressing Confucius on it harm righteousness? To strike at Confucius's claims with genuine understanding of the sage's work—what violation of reason is that?
process_zh: 对既定命题提出定义性问题：它究竟主张什么
追问机制：这如何发生，原因链条是什么
检验主张与主张者其他言行之间的一致性
用归谬与反例迫使含糊处显形
process_en: Pose definitional questions: what exactly does the proposition claim
Probe mechanism: how does it occur, what is the causal chain
Check consistency between the claim and the claimant's other words and deeds
Use reductio and counterexamples to force vagueness into view
representative_cases_zh: 《问孔》逐条质疑孔子言论的自相矛盾处
追问「死生有命富贵在天」：若命定一切，何须修养努力
representative_cases_en: Item-by-item questioning of contradictions in Confucius's sayings
If fate fixes wealth and honor, why cultivate oneself at all

modes.definition_zh: 把天道理解为人格化的自然过程而非有意志的干预者：「天地合气，万物自生，犹夫妇合气，子自生矣」。天不生谷物以供仁者，也不生灾异以谴告失道——「谴告」说是人把自己的心理投射到天上。王充对董仲舒天人感应论的批判是釜底抽薪式的：不是争论天的意志内容，而是取消「天有意志」这个前提本身。自然（自而然）是比任何目的论解释更朴素也更可检验的默认选项。
modes.definition_en: "Heaven and earth join their qi and the myriad things arise of themselves, as husband and wife join and children arise." Heaven neither grows grain to feed the virtuous nor sends disasters to admonish the wayward—the theory of admonitory omens projects human psychology onto the sky. Wang Chong's critique of Dong Zhongshu's resonance theory removes the foundation rather than disputing content: it cancels the premise that Heaven has a will at all. Spontaneity (zi-ran: self-so) is a plainer, more testable default than any teleology.
modes.source_chapter: 《论衡·自然》《论衡·物势》《论衡·谴告》
modes.key_quote_zh: 天地合气，万物自生。天动不欲以生物，而物自生，此则自然也。
modes.key_quote_en: Heaven and earth conjoin their qi and the myriad things arise of themselves. Heaven does not move intending to generate things, yet things arise: that is spontaneity.
process_zh: 识别将自然现象人格化/目的化的解释倾向
追问该解释的意志假设是否有独立证据
还原为物质过程：谁在动、什么在聚散
拒绝引入不可验证的神圣意图作为解释项
process_en: Spot personifying/teleological readings of natural phenomena
Ask whether the will-assumption has independent evidence
Reduce to material process: what moves, what condenses and disperses
Refuse unverifiable divine intention as an explanatory item
representative_cases_zh: 批判谴告说：天若谴告人君，何不径直使其改过而要假借灾异
以夫妇合气喻万物自生，取消造物者
representative_cases_en: Critique of admonitory omens: if Heaven meant to warn rulers, why not make them reform directly
The husband-wife qi analogy cancels any creator

modes.definition_zh: 「事莫明于有效，论莫定于有证」——任何论断的成立标准不是权威层级而是可检验证据。王充把「效验」立为知识的裁决程序：主张先化为可观测命题，再以实际事态验证，传闻与权威证词降级为待检输入。这使他在谶纬弥漫的东汉宫廷学术之外，独立走出一条以证据为中心的认识论路线，比培根的归纳法早约一千五百年。
modes.definition_en: "Nothing clarifies a matter like an effect; nothing settles an argument like evidence." A claim's warrant is not authority rank but testable evidence. Wang Chong made verification (xiao-yan) the adjudication procedure of knowledge: convert claims into observable propositions, check against actual states of affairs, demote hearsay and testimony to inputs pending test. Amid Han apocrypha he independently pioneered an evidence-centered epistemology, some 1500 years before Bacon.
modes.source_chapter: 《论衡·证验》《论衡·知实》《论衡·案书》
modes.key_quote_zh: 事莫明于有效，论莫定于有证。
modes.key_quote_en: Nothing clarifies a matter like an effect; nothing settles a disputation like verification.
process_zh: 把待检验主张表述为可观测命题
设计检验：观察现象是否符合该主张的预期
收集实证而非传闻；传闻必须标注来源与衰减层级
以检验结果裁定主张，不以主张裁剪检验
process_en: Restate the claim as an observable proposition
Design the check: does observation match the claim's expectation
Collect evidence not hearsay; tag hearsay by source and decay
Rule by test outcome, never edit the test to fit the claim
representative_cases_zh: 以亲身观察与记录检验雷电成因
知实篇以圣人事迹检验「生而知之」说
representative_cases_en: Testing lightning's cause against direct observation
Testing the "born knowing" doctrine against sages' biographical facts

modes.definition_zh: 暂时接受对方前提，按逻辑推出其全部后果，若结论荒谬则前提必误。王充用归谬法清理谶纬与俗信：若龙能致云雨升天，则龙应常在雨中而非藏于渊；若天人感应则以同类相动，天动何以感人而人不动天。他常连用多层归谬，把一个流行观念的隐藏承诺逐一兑现，让荒谬自己站出来。这是形式逻辑精神在中国中古时期的成熟运用。
modes.definition_en: Provisionally accept the opponent's premise, derive all its consequences, and if absurd results follow the premise fails. Wang Chong cleared apocrypha and folk beliefs by reductio: if dragons summon rain, why do they hide in deep pools rather than live in rain; if heaven-human resonance works by kind stirring kind, why does heaven move humans while humans cannot move heaven. He stacks reductios, cashing out a popular notion's hidden commitments one by one until absurdity shows itself.
modes.source_chapter: 《论衡·道虚》《论衡·龙虚》《论衡·纪妖》
modes.key_quote_zh: 龙不致云，云亦不致龙。今龙在渊中，亡则失其居矣——说龙致雨者，不知龙之实也。
modes.key_quote_en: Dragons do not summon clouds, nor clouds dragons: dragons dwell in deep pools—those who say dragons make rain do not know what dragons are.
process_zh: 暂时接受对方的前提或主张
按逻辑穷尽推导该主张的全部后果
指出其中荒谬或不可接受的结论
据此否定原主张，或迫使其收缩为可辩护形式
process_en: Temporarily accept the opponent's premise
Derive its full logical consequences
Point to the absurd or unacceptable results
Reject the premise or force it into a defensible reduced form
representative_cases_zh: 道虚篇对升仙说的连续归谬
龙虚篇对龙致雨说的多重反驳
representative_cases_en: Chained reductios against immortality-flight claims in Dao Xu
Multiple reductios against dragon-rainmaking in Long Xu
modern_applications_zh: 论证评审与边界条件检验
谈判中放大对方承诺检验诚意

modes.definition_zh: 以气为唯一本体解释一切：「万物之生，皆禀元气」。人也是气聚之物，「人未生在元气之中，既死复归元气」，故形亡神灭、无鬼。王充的气一元论把本体论与批判哲学焊接在一起：因为一切皆气之聚散，所以一切超自然实体（鬼神、天命、符瑞）都失去存在位置——本体论为怀疑论提供弹药。这使王充不只是「批判者」，而是有正面哲学体系的自然主义者。
modes.definition_en: Qi as the sole substance of everything: "all things are endowed with primal qi." Humans too are condensations of qi—"before birth we are within primal qi, after death we return to it"—hence with the body the spirit perishes and there are no ghosts. Wang Chong's monism welds ontology to critique: since all is condensation and dispersion of qi, every supernatural entity (ghosts, Heaven's mandate, auspicious portents) loses its place—ontology supplies ammunition for skepticism. He is not merely a critic but a naturalist with a positive system.
modes.source_chapter: 《论衡·谈天》《论衡·订鬼》《论衡·论死》
modes.key_quote_zh: 万物之生，皆禀元气。人未生在元气之中，既死复归元气。
modes.key_quote_en: All things at birth are endowed with primal qi. Before birth one is within primal qi; after death one returns to it.
process_zh: 将一切现象还原为物质性的气与形
以气的聚散、升降、感应解释变化
拒绝引入超自然实体作为独立原因
检查解释的简洁性与内在一致性
process_en: Reduce all phenomena to material qi and form
Explain change by condensation, rising-falling, and interaction of qi
Refuse supernatural entities as independent causes
Check explanations for parsimony and internal consistency
representative_cases_zh: 订鬼篇：鬼为人生病时气的幻觉投射，非实存实体
论死篇系统论证形亡神灭
representative_cases_en: Ding Gui: ghosts as hallucinated projections of qi in illness, not entities
Lun Si: systematic argument that spirit perishes with the body

modes.definition_zh: 以日常经验和普通人可验证的观察为检验理论的底尺，反对把神秘化解释强加于简单现象。王充论证雷电时先问：以雷杀人的是什么——若天怒，何以不分善恶？这是把哲学问题翻译成街巷可验之问的能力：理论的最终解释义务是向没有专门训练的人讲清楚。常识不是真理标准本身，而是「举证责任转移器」：越偏离常识的解释，越需要额外证据。
modes.definition_en: Use everyday experience and vernacularly checkable observation as the baseline test, refusing mystified explanations for simple phenomena. Arguing about lightning, Wang Chong first asks: what kills when thunder strikes—if Heaven's wrath, why does it not discriminate good from evil? This is the skill of translating philosophical questions into street-verifiable ones: a theory's final explanatory duty is to be clear to the untrained. Common sense is not truth itself but a burden-shifter: the further an explanation departs from it, the more extra evidence it owes.
modes.source_chapter: 《论衡·雷虚》《论衡·说日》《论衡·寒温》
modes.key_quote_zh: 实说雷电为火，隆隆之声，气相激之效也——世俗以为天怒，虚妄之言也。
modes.key_quote_en: The real account: thunder is fire; its rumble is the effect of qi striking qi. The world takes it for Heaven's wrath—empty talk.
process_zh: 把抽象命题翻译为日常可检验的形式
检查解释是否需要超出观察的额外假设
用普通人可复现的例证说明问题
对偏离常识的解释要求加倍的证据
process_en: Translate abstract claims into everyday testable form
Check whether the explanation needs assumptions beyond observation
Illustrate with examples anyone can reproduce
Demand doubled evidence for explanations far from common experience
representative_cases_zh: 雷虚篇：以「何不分善恶而击」瓦解天怒说
说日篇以日常观测讨论日远近之辩
representative_cases_en: Lei Xu: "why strike without regard to good and evil" dissolves the wrath theory
Shuo Ri: using plain observation on debates about the sun's distance

modes.definition_zh: 对经典文本本身进行批判性审计：区分真孔孟之言与后人伪托、误传与增益。王充的「语增」「儒增」「艺增」三增专攻转述放大机制——夸饰如何随转述升级为事实。真理不因出身权威而成立，文本不因古老而免检。他把审计程序（对照可验事实、找内部矛盾、分离原始层与附会层）前置到阅读阶段，创立了中国最早的系统性辨伪方法论。
modes.definition_en: Audit canonical texts themselves: separate authentic sayings from later forgeries, misattributions, and accretions. Wang Chong's "three exaggerations" target the amplification mechanics of transmission—how rhetorical flourish upgrades into fact through retelling. Truth does not hold because born of authority; texts are not exempt from inspection for being old. By front-loading audit procedures (checking against verifiable facts, finding internal contradictions, separating original strata from gloss) into reading itself, he founded China's earliest systematic forgery-detection methodology.
modes.source_chapter: 《论衡·书虚》《论衡·语增》《论衡·儒增》《论衡·艺增》
modes.key_quote_zh: 世儒学者，好信师而是古，以为贤圣所言皆无非——虽明知其非而莫敢难者，问难之道废也。
modes.key_quote_en: Scholars of the age trust their teachers and revere antiquity, holding whatever sages said blameless—knowing it false yet daring not challenge it: the way of questioning is dead.
process_zh: 把文本主张与可验证事实逐一对照
检索文本内部的矛盾与不一致
分离原始主张与后世附会增益层
以事实而非作者身份裁定文本可信度
process_en: Check textual claims against verifiable facts item by item
Search the text for internal contradictions
Separate the original claim from later accretions
Rule on credibility by facts, not author identity
representative_cases_zh: 书虚篇逐条核查传世史传中的虚增记载
语增篇分析夸饰如何随转述升级
representative_cases_en: Shu Xu: item-wise audit of inflated accounts in transmitted histories
Yu Zeng: how hyperbole upgrades through retelling

modes.definition_zh: 用物质性因果链取代目的论与感应论：每个现象都必须有清晰的「谁作用于谁、通过什么介质」的回答。王充解释雷电为「阴阳之气相激」、解释潮汐为月的引力对应、解释水循环为「雨从地上出，复入于地」——在天人感应弥漫的时代，他坚持因果必须闭合在物质世界之内。凡不能指明介质与链条的「感应」，一律视为描述而非解释。
modes.definition_en: Replace teleology and resonance with material causal chains: every phenomenon must answer who acts on what through which medium. Wang Chong explained thunder as yin-yang qi striking, tides as correspondence with the moon, and the water cycle as "rain issues from the earth and returns into it." In an age saturated with heaven-human resonance he insisted causation close within the material world: any "resonance" that cannot name its medium and chain is description, not explanation.
modes.source_chapter: 《论衡·雷虚》《论衡·感虚》《论衡·顺鼓》
modes.key_quote_zh: 夫雷之发动，一气一声也——人受气于天，不能感天，雷何为感于人而发？
modes.key_quote_en: Thunder's burst is one qi, one sound: humans receive qi from heaven yet cannot move heaven—how would thunder burst in response to humans?
process_zh: 追踪现象的物质性来源与传递介质
建立清晰的原因-结果链条
检验链条每一环是否可独立观察
凡缺失介质的「感应」说法降级为待证假设
process_en: Trace the material source and transmitting medium
Build an explicit cause-effect chain
Check each link is independently observable
Demote any "resonance" lacking a named medium to unproven hypothesis
representative_cases_zh: 雷虚篇的雷电火气说与「冶炼之火」类比
水循环与云雨成因的物质解释
representative_cases_en: Thunder-as-fire with the metallurgy analogy
Material accounts of the water cycle and cloud-rain formation

modes.definition_zh: 拒绝把权威、传统或多数意见当作真理标准：「世儒学者好信师而是古」正是认知自主的死敌。王充的做法不是为反而反，而是把「主张」与「主张来源」剥离——孔曰、俗云、众皆是三种不同类型的待检输入，检验程序完全相同。他明知问孔刺孟会招致「非圣无法」的骂名仍坚持为之，将认知自主的代价计入方法之内：独立检验的学费是声望，而收益是真知。
modes.definition_en: Refuse authority, tradition, or majority opinion as truth standards—"trusting teachers and revering antiquity" is the mortal enemy of intellectual autonomy. Wang Chong's method is not contrarianism but severing claim from source: sage-said, convention-says, and crowd-agrees are three kinds of untested input subject to one identical checking procedure. Knowing that questioning Confucius would earn the charge of impiety, he pressed on anyway—pricing the cost of autonomy into the method: tuition in reputation, return in true knowledge.
modes.source_chapter: 《论衡·问孔》《论衡·非韩》《论衡·别通》
modes.key_quote_zh: 距师千里，背经万里——虽违孔氏之说，实未违道也。
modes.key_quote_en: To part from one's teacher by a thousand li, from the classics by ten thousand—though it contradicts Confucius, it does not contradict the Way.
process_zh: 识别主张对来源权威的依赖程度
把主张与来源剥离后独立陈述
用统一程序检验，不论主张出身
承担独立检验的社会成本并预先计入
process_en: Gauge how much the claim leans on source authority
Restate the claim severed from its source
Apply one uniform checking procedure regardless of pedigree
Pre-pay the social cost of independent verification
representative_cases_zh: 问孔刺孟的历史担当与自辩
非韩篇对法家权威的批判性重估
representative_cases_en: Shouldering and self-defending the questioning of Confucius and Mencius
Critical revaluation of Legalist authority in Fei Han
